This script is aimed to explore the number of ATAC-seq, DNase-seq and ChIP-seq
experiments processed with the Ensembl Regulation [primary analysis pipeline](https://regulation.ensembl.org/help/primary_processing)
and released in [Ensembl 114](https://ftp.ensembl.org/pub/release-114/regulation/). 


```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(bedtoolsr)
library(RPostgreSQL)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(ggfortify)
library(ggh4x)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggnewscale)
```

Connecting with the `Regulation Data Registry` database: 

```{r}
db <- 'rdr'  

host_db <- 'localhost' 

db_port <- '2345' 

db_user <- 'regulation_usr'

db_password <- 'docker'

con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(), dbname = db, host = host_db, 
                 port = db_port, user = db_user, password = db_password)  

```

Querying `analysis_file` information for open chromatin and ChIP-seq experiments:

```{r, message = FALSE}
queryAnalysisFiles <- "SELECT * FROM analysis_file 
WHERE analysis_type IN ('atac_seq_peaks', 'dnase_seq_peaks',
'chip_seq_gapped_peaks', 'chip_seq_narrow_peaks')"

analysisMetadata <- dbGetQuery(con, queryAnalysisFiles, collapse="")
```

Querying `experiment` information for retrieved experiments:

```{r, message = FALSE}
queryExperiments <- paste("SELECT * FROM experiment_metadata 
                          WHERE replicate_set_type = 'signal' AND
                          experiment_id IN (", 
                          paste(paste(paste("'", 
                                        unique(analysisMetadata$experiment_id),
                                        sep = ""), collapse = "',"), "')",
                                sep = ""), sep = "")

expMetadata <- dbGetQuery(con, queryExperiments, collapse="")

```

Combining `analysis_file` and `experiment` metadata tables: 

```{r, message = FALSE}
analysisMetadata %>% 
  select(experiment_id, handover) %>% 
  unique() %>%
  left_join(expMetadata %>%
              select(species_name, epigenome_name, name, experiment_id,
                     experiment_type, experiment_target_type, 
                     experiment_target, biomaterial_type, biosample_term,
                     organ_slims, cell_slims, system_slims, life_stage_term,
                     age_at_collection, age_at_collection_unit,thermal_time,
                     age, age_unit, sex) %>%
              unique(), relationship = "many-to-many") -> analysisMetadata
```

Unifying metadata information across replicates:

```{r, message = FALSE}
analysisMetadata %>%
  replace_na(list(biomaterial_type='', biosample_term='', organ_slims='',
                  cell_slims='', system_slims='', life_stage_term = '', 
                  age_at_collection='', age_at_collection_unit = '', age = '', 
                  age_unit = '', sex = '')) -> analysisMetadata

analysisMetadata %>%
  group_by(species_name, epigenome_name, name,
           experiment_id, experiment_type, experiment_target_type, 
           experiment_target, handover) %>%
  summarise(biomaterial_type = paste(unique(biomaterial_type), collapse = ''),
            biosample_term = paste(unique(biosample_term), collapse =''), 
            organ_slims = paste(unique(organ_slims), collapse =''), 
            cell_slims = paste(unique(cell_slims), collapse =''), 
            system_slims = paste(unique(system_slims), collapse =''), 
            life_stage_term = paste(unique(life_stage_term), collapse =''), 
            age = paste(sort(unique(age)), collapse = ''),
            age_unit = paste(sort(unique(age_unit)), collapse = ''),
            age_at_collection = paste(sort(unique(age_at_collection)),
                                      collapse = ''),
            age_at_collection_unit = paste(sort(unique(age_at_collection_unit)),
                                      collapse = ''),
            thermal_time = paste(sort(unique(thermal_time)),
                                      collapse = ''),
            sex = paste(sort(unique(sex)), collapse = '')) %>%
  as.data.frame() -> analysisMetadata

```

Keeping experiments that have been handed over in e!114:

```{r, message = FALSE}
analysisMetadata %>%
  filter(handover) -> handoverMetadata
```

Parsing species, experiment, and biomaterial type names:

```{r, message = FALSE}
speciesMap <- c('Human', 'Mouse', 'Pig', 'Chicken', 'Cattle', 'Atlantic salmon',
                'Rainbow trout', 'Turbot', 'European seabass', 'Common carp')
names(speciesMap)<- c('Homo sapiens', 'Mus musculus', 'Sus scrofa',
                      'Gallus gallus', 'Bos taurus', 'Salmo salar', 
                      'Oncorhynchus mykiss', 'Scophthalmus maximus', 
                      'Dicentrarchus labrax', 'Cyprinus carpio carpio')

handoverMetadata %>%
  mutate(experiment_target = if_else(experiment_target == 'atac_seq', 
                                     'ATAC', experiment_target)) %>%
  mutate(experiment_target = if_else(experiment_target == 'dnase_seq', 
                                     'DNase', 
                                     experiment_target)) %>%
  mutate(species = speciesMap[species_name]) %>%
  mutate(experiment_target = factor(experiment_target, 
                                    levels = c('ATAC', 'DNase', 'H3K4me3',
                                               'H3K27ac', 'H3K4me1', 
                                               'H3K27me3', 'CTCF')),
         species_name = factor(species_name, levels = names(speciesMap)),
         species = factor(species, levels = speciesMap),
         biomaterial_type = factor(str_replace_all(biomaterial_type, '_', ' '), 
                                   levels = c("primary tissue", 
                                              "primary cell", "cell line",
                                              "primary cell culture"))
         ) -> handoverMetadata
```


Number of experiments per species

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, meassage = FALSE}
handoverMetadata %>%
  select(species, experiment_target) %>%
  group_by(species, experiment_target) %>%
  summarise( n = n()) %>% as.data.frame() -> dfPlot

markCols <- c('chartreuse3', 'darkolivegreen', 'red2', 'gold', 'peru',
              'darkviolet', 'cyan3')
names(markCols) <- levels(dfPlot$experiment_target)

g <- ggplot(dfPlot) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = 1, y = 1, 
                   # color = species,
                   fill = experiment_target, alpha = n), stat = 'identity',
               position = position_dodge(width = 1)) +
      geom_text(aes( x = 1, y = 0.5, label = n), size = 5) + 
      facet_nested( experiment_target ~ species, 
                    scales = 'free_x', drop = TRUE, space = 'free') +
      theme_bw() +  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
      labs(x = '', y = '', fill = '', color = '') +
      theme(legend.position = 'none', axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
            strip.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold'), 
            strip.text.y = element_text(face = 'bold')) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = markCols)  

g
```

Removing H3K27me3 and combining open chromatin data

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5, message = FALSE}
handoverMetadata %>%
  filter(experiment_target != 'H3K27me3') %>%
  select(species, experiment_target) %>%
  mutate(experiment_target = if_else(experiment_target %in% c('ATAC','DNase'),
                                     'ATAC \n DNase', experiment_target)) %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace_all(species, ' ', '\n')) %>%
  group_by(species, experiment_target) %>%
  summarise( n = n()) %>% as.data.frame() ->dfPlot

dfPlot %>%
  mutate(experiment_target = factor(experiment_target, 
                                    levels = c("ATAC \n DNase","H3K4me3",
                                               "H3K27ac", "H3K4me1", 
                                               "CTCF"))) %>%
  mutate(species = factor(species, levels = c("Human", "Mouse", "Pig",
                                              "Chicken", "Cattle", 
                                              "Atlantic\nsalmon",
                                               "European\nseabass", "Turbot",
                                              "Rainbow\ntrout", 
                                              "Common\ncarp")))-> dfPlot
markCols <- c('chartreuse3', 'red2', 'gold', 'peru','cyan3')
names(markCols) <- unique(dfPlot$experiment_target)

g <- ggplot(dfPlot) +
      geom_bar(aes(x = 1, y = 1, 
                   # color = species,
                   fill = experiment_target, alpha = n), stat = 'identity',
               position = position_dodge(width = 1)) +
      geom_text(aes( x = 1, y = 0.5, label = n), size = 5) + 
      facet_nested( experiment_target ~ species, 
                    scales = 'free_x', drop = TRUE, space = 'free') +
      theme_bw() +  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE) +
      labs(x = '', y = '', fill = '', color = '') +
      theme(legend.position = 'none', axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), axis.text.y = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
            strip.text.x = element_text(size = 11,face = 'bold'), 
            strip.text.y = element_text(size = 11,face = 'bold')
            ) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = markCols)  
  # scale_color_manual(values = specCols)
g
```

Number of experiments per biomaterial type and per species:

```{r, fig.width=24, fig.height=9, message = FALSE}
handoverMetadata %>%
  select(species, experiment_target, biomaterial_type,

  group_by(species, experiment_target, biomaterial_type) %>%
  summarise( n = n()) %>% as.data.frame() ->dfPlot

specCols <- c('darkgreen', 'olivedrab3', 'midnightblue', 
              'purple4','darkturquoise', 'red2','darkorange', 'hotpink', 'tomato3',
              'darkgoldenrod4')
names(specCols) <- speciesMap

               position = position_dodge(width = 1)) +
      geom_text(aes( x = 1, y = 0.5, label = n), size = 5) +

  # scale_color_manual(values = specCols)
g
```

Parsing tissues names or biosample terms in order to define `biosample groups` 
of epigenomes from cell lines and closely-related tissues:

```{r, message = FALSE}
handoverMetadata %>% 
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(biosample_term == 'immature gonad',
                                  'gonad', biosample_term)) %>% 
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('adipose', biosample_group),
                        'adipose', biosample_group)) %>% 
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('brain', biosample_group) |
                                     grepl('brain', organ_slims) |
                                     grepl('cortex', biosample_group) |
                                     grepl('cerebellum', biosample_group) |
                                     grepl('hypothalamus', biosample_group) |
                                     grepl('neural progenitor',biosample_group),
                                   'brain', biosample_group)) %>% 
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('neuron', biosample_group), 
                                   'neural cell', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('heart', biosample_group) |
                                     grepl('heart', organ_slims), 'heart',
                                   biosample_group)) %>% 
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('tibial nerve', biosample_group), 
                                   'limb', biosample_group)) %>%   
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('lung', organ_slims) |
                                     grepl('lung', biosample_group), 'lung',    
                                   biosample_group)) %>% 
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('pancreas', organ_slims), 'pancreas',
                                   biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('intestine', organ_slims) | 
                                     grepl('ileum', biosample_group) |
                                     grepl('intestine', biosample_group), 
                                   'intestine', biosample_group)) %>% 
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('muscle', biosample_group) | 
                                     grepl('musculature', organ_slims) |
                                     grepl('gluteus', biosample_group) | 
                                     grepl('skeletal', biosample_group) | 
                                     grepl('longissimus', biosample_group),
                                   'muscle', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('stomach', organ_slims),
                                   'stomach', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('spleen', organ_slims) |
                                     grepl('thymus', organ_slims) |
                                     grepl('spleen', biosample_group) |
                                     grepl('hymus', biosample_group),
                                   'immune organ', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('endocrine', organ_slims), 
                                   'endocrine gland', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('testis', biosample_group) | 
                                     grepl('testis', organ_slims), 'gonad',
                                   biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('epithel', organ_slims),
                                   'epithelium', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('kidney', organ_slims) | 
                                     grepl('kidney', biosample_group) |     
                                     grepl('mesonephros', biosample_group), 
                                   'kidney', biosample_group)) %>%  
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('liver', organ_slims) |
                                     grepl('liver', biosample_group), 'liver',
                                   biosample_group)) %>% 
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('embryo', organ_slims), 'embryonic',
                                   biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('skin', biosample_group) | 
                                     grepl('skin', organ_slims), 'skin', 
                                   biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('blood vessel', organ_slims), 
                                   'blood vessel', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('tibial nerve', organ_slims), 'limb',
                                   biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('bone marrow', organ_slims), 
                                   'bone marrow', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('blood', organ_slims) |
                                     grepl('B cell', cell_slims)|
                                     (grepl('hematopoietic', cell_slims)  & 
                                        !(grepl('bone marrow', 
                                                handoverMetadata$biosample_term))),
                                   'blood', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('connective tissue', organ_slims),
                                   'connective tissue', biosample_group)) %>%
  mutate(biosample_group = if_else(grepl('terus', biosample_group) |
                                     grepl('prostate', organ_slims) |
                                     grepl('vagina', organ_slims),
                                   'reproductive', biosample_group)
         ) -> handoverMetadata
```

Number of experiment per biosample group and per species:

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=10, message = FALSE}
handoverMetadata %>%
  select(species, experiment_target, biosample_group, 
          life_stage_term, sex) %>%
  group_by(species, experiment_target, biosample_group) %>%
  summarise( n = n()) %>% as.data.frame() ->dfPlot

markCols <- c('chartreuse3', 'darkolivegreen', 'red2', 'gold', 'peru',
              'darkviolet', 'cyan3')
names(markCols) <- levels(dfPlot$experiment_target)
dfPlot %>%
  arrange(desc(biosample_group))-> dfPlot
dfPlot[,'biosample_group'] <- factor(dfPlot[,'biosample_group'],
                                     levels = unique(dfPlot$biosample_group))

```

Figure **2A**: Tetrapods

```{r, fig.width=12,fig.height=8, message = FALSE}
tetrapods <- c('Human', 'Mouse', 'Pig', 'Chicken', 'Cattle')
alphaScale <- c('0', '1','2-5','>5')

dfPlot %>%
  filter(species %in% tetrapods) %>%
  mutate(nDisc = cut(n, breaks = c(-Inf,0,1,5,Inf), 
                     labels = alphaScale)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_tile(aes(x = experiment_target, y = biosample_group,
                fill = experiment_target, alpha = nDisc)) +
  geom_text(aes( x = experiment_target, y = biosample_group, label = n),
            size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ species,  drop = TRUE, nrow = 1 ) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE)  +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = 'none', axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold'), 
        strip.text.y = element_text(face = 'bold'),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = markCols) + 
  scale_alpha_discrete(c(0,1), name = '# of experiments') +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1), alpha =guide_legend(nrow = 1) ) +
  labs(x = '', y = '', fill = '') -> tetrapods_plot
```

Extracting plot legends:

```{r, message = FALSE}
tetrapods_legend <-get_plot_component(tetrapods_plot + 
                                        theme(legend.position = 'bottom')+
                                       guides(alpha = 'none'),
                                      'guide-box', return_all = TRUE)
```

Figure **2B**: Fishes

```{r, fig.width=12,fig.height=3.5, message = FALSE}
fishes <- c('Atlantic salmon', 'Common carp', 'European seabass',
            'Rainbow trout', 'Turbot')

dfPlot %>%
  filter(species %in% fishes) %>%
  mutate(nDisc = cut(n, breaks = c(-Inf,0,1,5,Inf), 
                     labels = alphaScale)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_tile(aes(x = experiment_target, y = biosample_group,
                fill = experiment_target, alpha = nDisc)) +
  geom_text(aes( x = experiment_target, y = biosample_group, label = n),
            size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ species,  drop = TRUE, nrow = 1 ) +
  coord_cartesian(expand = FALSE)  +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = 'bottom', axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), 
        axis.ticks.y = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text.x = element_text(face = 'bold'), 
        strip.text.y = element_text(face = 'bold'),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white'))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = markCols) + 
  scale_alpha_discrete(c(0,1), name = '# of experiments') +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1), alpha =guide_legend(nrow = 1) ) +
  labs(x = '', y = '', fill = '') -> fishes_plot
```

Arranging both panel in a single figure:

```{r, fig.width=10,fig.height= 9.6, message = FALSE}
Figure2 <- plot_grid(plot_grid(tetrapods_plot, 
                    # adding and empty plot just for adjusting margins 
                    plot_grid(ggplot() + 
                                theme(panel.background = 
                                        element_rect (fill = 'white')),
                              fishes_plot +
                                theme(legend.position = 'none'), nrow =1, 
                              rel_widths = c(0.035,1)),
                    labels = c('Tetrapods', 'Fishes'), 
                    nrow = 2, rel_heights = c(1,0.4)),
                    # adding legend
                    tetrapods_legend,
                    nrow =2, rel_heights = c(1, 0.05))
Figure2
```
